properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Sheet metal thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: InsulationThickness
properties.description: Insulation thickness wrapped around the outside of the fitting; 0 disables insulation

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the straight collar between the fitting and the duct

properties.name: SlotLength
properties.description: Length of the slot face. 0 uses four times the duct size

properties.name: SlotWidth
properties.description: Width of the slot face. 0 uses half the duct size

properties.name: BodyLength
properties.description: Length of the boot from the duct to the face. 0 uses the duct size

properties.name: LossMode
properties.description: How the loss is given: a coefficient K, or a fixed pressure drop from the maker's data

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to velocity at the neck

properties.name: NeckSize
properties.description: Equivalent neck diameter the loss coefficient refers to. Used for the loss only, not for the shape

properties.name: PressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at the design flow, used when LossMode is Fixed pressure drop

properties.name: FlangeHeight
properties.description: Height of the transverse flange at each duct connection

properties.name: FlangeThickness
properties.description: Thickness of the transverse flange; 0 draws no flanges

properties.name: ShowFlange1
properties.description: Include the flange at the duct connection
